chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the water of the sea: is it purifying? He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.طَهُورٌ: ritually purifying and suitable for purification

ai.seo_question: Is sea water valid for ritual purification in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states that sea water is ṭahūr, meaning it is pure and suitable for ritual purification. It serves as a concise legal proof in the rulings of taharah regarding the permissibility of using sea water for purification.
